_comment: Work Lamar puts your way. Edited here, reloaded on script start.
ORDER MATTERS. He works down this list in the order it is written and offers you the
first one you have not finished. Only once every job here is behind you does he stop
deciding and let you pick. Finished jobs are remembered by id in the save, so adding a
job or moving one does not re-lock work you have already done.
id          stable key; never change it once a save references it
kind        BikeRide | RideOut | Hit | DriveBy
BikeRide  the scripted push-bike job -- fixed route, no guns on either side
RideOut   ride out, hands only, both sides
Hit       same trip, everybody armed, the corner shoots back
DriveBy   take a car past and shoot it up without stopping
name        the choice he offers you, in his words
brief       what he says when he explains it
done        what he says when you come back paid
targetGang  whose people you are going after -- their models and colours are used
zone        GET_NAME_OF_ZONE code the job happens in, used for the objective wording
x, y, z     the exact corner they stand on. Leave all three at 0 and the job falls back
to the middle of the zone, which for a big zone can be a block away from the
place you actually meant. BikeRide ignores these -- its route is fixed.
targets     how many of them are waiting
homies      how many of yours ride out with you
escapeHeat  true if the law turns up once the work is done. Lamar will not take it off
you until the stars are gone, so the trip home is part of the job.
heatStars   how many stars escapeHeat applies. Ignored when escapeHeat is false.
payMin/payMax  cash, rolled between the two
rep         standing with your own gang for finishing it
minRank     rank before he will offer it at all

missions.name: Come take a ride with me.
missions.brief: Aight, Frank, check this out. Ballas been posted on the Chamberlain courts all week like somebody signed 'em a lease. Nobody hooped down there since Tuesday. TUESDAY.
missions.done: HA! Look at you! That's how we used to do it, boy. My hand still hurt and I wasn't even swingin'.
briefMore: Now I could get somebody shot over it. I could. But then the law's all over this block by dinner, over a basketball court, and everybody out here loses everything on account of nothing. Nah. We better than that. I'M better than that.

So we do it how we did it at fifteen. Get a bike, roll out with the homies, hands only. That's it. That's the whole plan and it's a beautiful plan. You pull somethin' out there, homie, and I ain't never met you in my life.

missions.name: Ride through Rancho and lose the car.
missions.brief: Rancho is yellow top to bottom and they ain't just standing out there, Frank, they SELLING. In Chamberlain. On Davis. Corners we been on since before you could drive.
missions.done: Seen the smoke from the freeway! No plate to run, no body to catch, and them Vagos sittin' there wonderin' who. That's exactly what I said would happen. I said it. Me.
briefMore: And I can't touch they price 'cause they gettin' it straight off Madrazo's people. I went to Stretch about it. Man looked me dead in my face and said leave it alone. So we ain't goin' through Stretch. This me and you. And we ain't droppin' nobody neither -- set's in pieces since Grove went purple, we can't win no war. It's a message.

Take the beater out front, roll through Jamestown, and soon as one of 'em looks up you gone. Then the car goes. Out to that lot by the water in La Puerta, gas all over it, put a round in it. Law looks for a plate, homie. Law don't look for a face. Then you walk back to me like a gentleman.

missions.name: Go put our set up.
missions.brief: You seen this fool UNIT? Big red letters, Forum Drive all the way down to the wash. Dude's from Ballas way and he treatin' this whole side like it's his little sketchpad.
missions.done: Drove past the one by the wash this mornin'. Straight over the top of him! He gon' see that and he gon' FEEL somethin'. Trust me.
briefMore: And where we at? Nowhere. Our set ain't on one wall out here. That's how a block stops bein' yours, Frank -- ain't nobody get shot, it's just some kid grows up here and never once sees our name on nothin'.

So get a bike, get a can, go straight over the top of him. Four walls, all local. And go by yourself -- two dudes on bikes with cans is a whole story, one dude is a kid. That's psychology right there. LD psychology.

missions.name: Rancho. Vagos.
missions.brief: Aight, no more messages. Vagos got a lil spot out Rancho where they break the weight down before it ever gets near us. Five of 'em out there posted up like it's somebody's barbecue.
missions.done: I heard about that before you even got back. Whole block heard. TAKE that.
briefMore: You take that off 'em, they gotta go get more, and gettin' more costs 'em. Costs 'em enough and all a sudden our price look reasonable again. That's it. That's the whole thing, don't overthink it, I already thought it.
Three homies, everybody with a machine pistol. Don't be bringin' no shotgun out there, this ain't huntin' season. And somebody ALWAYS calls the law, so lose 'em before you come back round here.

missions.name: Ballas on Grove.
missions.brief: Ballas standin' on Grove. On GROVE, Frank. My granddaddy's street. I ain't even bein' dramatic right now, I'm bein' the opposite of dramatic.
missions.done: THAT'S what I'm talkin' about! Word travels, homie. Word travels FAST out here and it's travellin' with my name on it.
briefMore: And yeah, I know it's theirs on paper. Everybody know that. But there's theirs on paper and there's them STANDIN' on it, and if we let 'em post up out there the old heads gon' stop callin' it ours at all. Then it's really gone. Then it's just a street.
It's two of 'em. Take three homies and everybody carry, I don't wanna hear nothin' about hands today. And you gon' pick up the law comin' out, so don't you dare bring it back round here.

missions.name: The Vagos need reminding.
missions.brief: La Mesa. Vagos been runnin' packs through there all month -- same weight, half the price, and every dollar of it comin' straight off our corners.
missions.done: That'll hold 'em a minute. They gon' be lookin' over they shoulder all week and I'ma be over here countin'.
briefMore: We took the Rancho spot and they just moved it. See, that's the thing about people with more spots than you. So we stop takin' spots. We make the ROUTE cost 'em instead. You see how I did that? That's chess, homie.
Drive through, make some noise, be gone before the law finish they donut. You ain't gotta be out there all day provin' somethin'. It's a message, not a visit.
